verdict.rationale: Supabase's own CLI stands up the whole stack headlessly with `supabase init` and `supabase start`, and is documented to run 'in a CI environment'. A community user confirms `supabase start` builds the instance from migration .sql files, so schema and RLS policies (plain SQL `create policy`) can be scripted, and the CLI-bundled local MCP server (`apply_migration`, `execute_sql`) plus `supabase db advisors` give agents a scriptable path to apply and verify them. Missing for 10: documented headless CLI configuration of auth providers/settings, an explicit end-to-end agent-scripted bootstrap example, and independent hands-on corroboration of a fully scripted setup.
